AI‑powered, evidence‑first troubleshooting for multi‑vendor networks.

NetCopilot turns plain‑English questions into verified diagnostics by calling live device tools and operational systems. Reduce MTTR, eliminate guesswork, and standardize triage across teams.

What it does

  • • Calls real CLI tools and returns evidence
  • • Vendor‑aware: Cisco, Juniper, Nokia
  • • Integrates with Jira, Slack, Prometheus
  • • Read‑only by design, audit‑ready

Core Capabilities

Natural‑language diagnostics

Ask plain questions and get structured answers with evidence from real devices.

End‑to‑end link validation

LLDP‑aware checks verify both local and remote sides before concluding root cause.

Operational playbooks

Flaps, BGP/ISIS down, CRC spikes, high CPU — guided and consistent.

Ticketing + ChatOps

Create or update tickets with structured diagnostics and share in Slack.

Flexible LLM backend

OpenAI, Bedrock, or local models via LiteLLM without code changes.

Admin controls

Role‑gated actions, audit logging, and safe tool execution.
